rationale: The workflow uses a matrix to build with different JDK versions (17 and 21). Since the build process involves downloading dependencies via Maven, adding a caching step for the Maven local repository (typically ~/.m2/repository) can allow the second job in the matrix to reuse the dependencies downloaded by the first job, provided the dependencies are compatible across JDKs. This implements the 'Reuse only input-compatible work' mechanism by caching the dependency download state.
